scripts.build:app: npm run build -w @chardesk/fonts && npm run build -w @chardesk/protocol && npm run build -w @chardesk/rendering && npm run build -w @chardesk/chargraph && node scripts/data/generate-welcome-canvas.mjs --verify && npm run build -w @chardesk/viewer && npm run build -w @chardesk/ui && npm run build -w @chardesk/blackboard && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build: npm run build -w @chardesk/fonts && npm run build -w @chardesk/protocol && npm run build -w @chardesk/rendering && npm run build -w @chardesk/chargraph && npm run build:cli && node scripts/data/generate-welcome-canvas.mjs --verify && npm run build -w @chardesk/viewer && npm run build -w @chardesk/ui && npm run build -w @chardesk/blackboard && tsc -b && vite build && npm run build:docs && npm run build:chargraph
scripts.build:docs: npm run build -w @chardesk/docs && node scripts/docs/merge-build.mjs && node scripts/docs/verify-build.mjs
scripts.build:chargraph: npm run build -w @chardesk/chargraph-site && node scripts/chargraph/merge-build.mjs && node scripts/chargraph/verify-build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @chardesk/ui && tsc -b --pretty false && npm run typecheck -w @chardesk/blackboard && npm run typecheck -w @chardesk/cli && npm run typecheck -w @chardesk/docs && npm run typecheck -w @chardesk/chargraph-site
scripts.welcome:generate: npm run build -w @chardesk/protocol && npm run build -w @chardesk/chargraph && node scripts/data/generate-welcome-canvas.mjs
scripts.welcome:verify: npm run build -w @chardesk/protocol && npm run build -w @chardesk/chargraph && node scripts/data/generate-welcome-canvas.mjs --verify
scripts.check:architecture: npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:type-escapes && npm run check:state-ownership && npm run check-style-api
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run knip && npm run check:architecture && npm run test:protocol && npm run test:chargraph && npm run test:cli && npm run test:blackboard && npm test -- --run && npm run build
